schema.description: Canonical schema discriminator. Aligned with schema-registry.json; lets validators distinguish identity registry receipts from other receipt envelopes (e.g. audit-ryw-receipt, event-batch-receipt).

did.description: Method-native bare full DID whose registry log position is attested by this receipt. This field intentionally remains a full DID because seq and head_event_digest identify that DID method history; it is not a stable Arkret business identity field.

registry_service_id.description: Stable core_id of the registry service issuing the receipt. The detached proof verification_method remains a full DID URL and MUST project to this value through the registered method adapter.

witness_role.description: Issuer's role in the DID registry consensus group. Required so verifiers can apply role-specific freshness / quorum rules; an absent role would force the verifier to guess writer vs replica semantics.

audience.description: Optional audience binding (verifier DID, service DID, or domain). When present, verifiers MUST reject the receipt outside that audience context to prevent cross-protocol reuse.

signature.description: Registry detached proof. payload_digest = sha256(canonical_json(receipt with signature omitted)). The detached JWS signs canonical_json({context:'ak.identity-receipt-proof-v1', payload_digest, registry_service_id, did, verification_method, created_at, domain?, audience?}); context is a fixed signing-context domain tag and is not a wire field. signature.created_at MUST equal receipt.created_at. signature.verification_method MUST be a currently valid full DID URL assertion method whose bare full_id is independently validated and projected to registry_service_id by the registered method adapter. Receipt audience and proof audience MUST either both be absent or be the same single string; array-valued proof audiences are invalid for this object family.
